speaking_invitation_statement: Dr. Zaid Amin is available for international academic keynotes, conference plenary talks, institutional workshops, and expert panel discussions on Human-Computer Interaction, AI Governance, Cognitive Attention Systems, and Digital Ethics. To invite Dr. Amin, please contact zaid.amin@newinti.edu.my.
